props.doc:
Where the official ATT&CK STIX bundle lives, per domain.

Named here rather than configured, because an ATT&CK bundle from an
unexpected origin is a supply-chain problem: every technique id in the
product would come from it. An installation that cannot reach GitHub uploads
the bundle instead, which is the air-gapped path and not a lesser one.
props.name: attack_bundle_url

props.code:
known = {
    "enterprise": "enterprise-attack",
    "mobile": "mobile-attack",
    "ics": "ics-attack",
}
name = known.get((domain or "enterprise").strip().lower())
if not name:
    raise ValueError("unknown ATT&CK domain %r; expected enterprise, mobile or ics"
                     % domain)
return ("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitre-attack/attack-stix-data/"
        "master/%s/%s.json" % (name, name))

props.doc:
Read an ATT&CK STIX bundle into technique rows.

Two decisions worth knowing about. A technique with no kill-chain phase is
skipped rather than stored: it would be a row in the coverage matrix with no
column to sit in. And a technique in several tactics keeps all of them -
T1078 is Defense Evasion, Persistence, Privilege Escalation AND Initial
Access, and a loader that keeps one silently makes three tactics look empty.
props.name: parse_attack_bundle

props.doc:
Load an ATT&CK bundle into mitre_technique, and record that the load happened.

Techniques absent from the bundle are left alone rather than marked revoked.
A SOC that loads the Enterprise bundle on a system that already has Mobile
would otherwise revoke every mobile technique, and the coverage view would
quietly lose half its rows. Only the bundle's own `revoked` flag revokes.
props.name: load_attack_bundle

props.code:
from soar.platform.ids import new_id

parsed = parse_attack_bundle(payload)
techniques = parsed["techniques"]
if not techniques:
    raise ValueError(
        "no usable attack-pattern objects in the bundle: %s"
        % ("; ".join(parsed["errors"][:3]) or "the document had none"))

rows = []
for technique in techniques:
    rows.append([
        technique["id"], technique["tactic"], technique["name"],
        technique["description"], technique["platforms"],
        technique["revoked"], technique["version"], technique["tactics"],
        technique["data_sources"], technique["detection"],
        technique["is_subtechnique"], technique["parent_id"],
        technique["url"], technique["last_modified"],
    ])

db.execute_many(
    "INSERT INTO mitre_technique (id, tactic, name, description, platforms, "
    "revoked, version, tactics, data_sources, detection, is_subtechnique, "
    "parent_id, url, last_modified, loaded_at) "
    "VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s, now()) "
    "ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET "
    "  tactic = EXCLUDED.tactic, name = EXCLUDED.name, "
    "  description = EXCLUDED.description, platforms = EXCLUDED.platforms, "
    "  revoked = EXCLUDED.revoked, version = EXCLUDED.version, "
    "  tactics = EXCLUDED.tactics, data_sources = EXCLUDED.data_sources, "
    "  detection = EXCLUDED.detection, "
    "  is_subtechnique = EXCLUDED.is_subtechnique, "
    "  parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id, url = EXCLUDED.url, "
    "  last_modified = EXCLUDED.last_modified, loaded_at = now()",
    rows, "",
)

load_id = new_id("atk")
db.execute(
    "INSERT INTO attack_bundle (id, source, spec_version, technique_count, "
    "error_count, loaded_at) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s, now())",
    [load_id, str(source)[:500], parsed.get("spec_version"),
     len(rows), len(parsed["errors"])],
    "",
)

return {"loaded": len(rows), "load_id": load_id,
        "spec_version": parsed.get("spec_version"),
        "skipped": parsed["errors"][:10]}
props.doc:
Load an ATT&CK bundle into mitre_technique, and record that the load happened.

Techniques absent from the bundle are left alone rather than marked revoked.
A SOC that loads the Enterprise bundle on a system that already has Mobile
would otherwise revoke every mobile technique, and the coverage view would
quietly lose half its rows. Only the bundle's own `revoked` flag revokes.
props.name: store_attack_bundle

props.doc: Whether ATT&CK reference data is present, and how old it is. An empty matrix and a stale one look identical on a coverage chart, so both are stated rather than inferred.
props.name: attack_status

props.code:
rows = db.query(
    "SELECT count(*) AS techniques, "
    "count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_subtechnique) AS sub_techniques, "
    "count(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked) AS revoked, "
    "count(DISTINCT tactic) AS tactics, "
    "max(loaded_at) AS loaded_at FROM mitre_technique", [], "",
)
summary = dict(rows[0]) if rows else {"techniques": 0}
summary["loaded"] = bool(summary.get("techniques"))
summary["loads"] = db.query(
    "SELECT id, source, spec_version, technique_count, error_count, loaded_at "
    "FROM attack_bundle ORDER BY loaded_at DESC LIMIT 5", [], "",
)
return summary
props.doc: Whether ATT&CK reference data is present, and how old it is. An empty matrix and a stale one look identical on a coverage chart, so both are stated rather than inferred.
props.name: summarise_attack_data
